skills.name: 流矢
skills.text: 出牌阶段，你可以将一张红桃牌置于牌堆顶，视为对一名角色使用一张无距离和次数限制的【杀】，若此【杀】造成伤害，其手牌上限-1。
notes: Modeled as a compulsory-offer playPhaseStarting trigger: selectTarget otherLivingVirtualSlashTarget, one heart hand card via selectAndMoveOwnedCard suits:[heart] to drawPileTop, then useVirtualCard slash with useCardActionWindows and distanceUnlimitedAgainstTarget.

The damaging aftermath is a compulsory cardUseCompleted trigger (ownerRelation actor, cardKinds slash) guarded by cardUseCausedDamage plus cardUseConversionSkillIs; the program virtual use now records its own CardConversionSource so the conversion-skill condition can match.
Aftermath effects: changeParticipantMarker marker liuShi +1 and adjustPersistentHandLimit -1 against the eventTarget; both op families gained owner-placeholder targetRef (eventTarget) support.

skills.name: 斩腕
skills.text: 锁定技，当受到“流矢”效果影响的角色于弃牌阶段弃牌后，你摸等量张牌并移除其“流矢”效果。
notes: Compulsory discardPhaseEnded trigger with turnOwnerScope otherLiving; condition compares eventTargetMarkerCount liuShi >= 1.
Draw amount uses the new numberExpression turnOwnerDiscardPhaseHandDiscardCount; then changeParticipantMarker -1 and adjustPersistentHandLimit +1 restore the limit.
DiscardPhaseEnded candidate collection overlays the phase owner's markers as eventTargetMarkerCounts so foreign-marker conditions evaluate; each discard-phase end removes one marker stack.

observations: OL lists 曹性 as qun 4HP with labels 进攻/控制/过牌; quality 稀有.
The hand-limit reduction is implemented with the persistent hand-limit public state; the event now carries TargetSeat so the adjustment lands on the victim instead of the skill owner.
Marker stacks drain one per affected discard phase; the fixture deck of heart nullifications keeps the AI from playing around the slash.
